reasons.plausibility: Introducing porosity into a brittle refractory high-entropy alloy is highly likely to severely degrade strength and fracture toughness, contradicting the goal of maintaining performance; the mechanism of crack arrest is speculative and unsupported for this alloy class.
reasons.testability: The test proposes sintering methods on an as-cast alloy and sets a vague falsification criterion that mixes density reduction and property loss, making it unclear what result would decisively falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a method (porosity) that is fundamentally detrimental to the mechanical properties the question explicitly requires to be maintained, offering no viable path for the research.
